file.device: disk drive 8, secondary address 255 -- an ordinary PRG save through the KERNAL, not the game's own block I/O
file.scratch_before_save: S0:QUESTn on the command channel, wrapped in I0 initialise commands
file.slot_digit: n = 0..4, the selected slot; the screen labels them 1-5
file.note: the two-byte little-endian load address comes first, then the payload; the game saves the range $2000-$257F

regions.name: object_room_lo
regions.meaning: for each of the 256 object numbers, the low byte of the room it is in

regions.name: object_flags
regions.meaning: bits 0-4 screen row, bit 5 carried by the player, bit 6 the object exists, bit 7 the high bit of its room number.  A flags byte of 0 is a free slot

regions.name: creature_banished
regions.meaning: indexed by creature id 1-127; bit 7 = banished by the wand of Befal.  Entries $34 and $35 double as the two permanent gate flags

regions.name: creature_day_stamp
regions.meaning: indexed by creature id 1-127; bits 0-6 = day last spoken to, bit 7 = spirit gift spent.  For ambushers bits 0-4 are the time-of-day slot they settled in

regions.name: variables
regions.meaning: a copy of the $0A00 variable page; the fields that matter are listed under `variables`.  Everything else is per-frame scratch and is overwritten before it is read

regions.name: zero_page
regions.meaning: a copy of zero page $80-$FF; the fields that matter are listed under `zero_page`

variables.name: tileset
variables.meaning: tile set of the current room

variables.name: loaded_player
variables.meaning: which character sprite file is in memory; LOAD deliberately restores the pre-load value instead of the saved one

variables.name: spirit_limit
variables.meaning: spirit limit; also the skill gate

variables.name: food_cap_plus1
variables.meaning: food is capped at this minus 1

variables.name: rest_cap_plus1
variables.meaning: rest is capped at this minus 1

variables.name: nid_room_lo
variables.meaning: home nid place, room low byte

variables.name: nid_room_hi
variables.meaning: home nid place, room high bit

variables.name: clock_period
variables.meaning: prescaler wraps left in this time slot

zero_page.name: room_lo
zero_page.meaning: current room, low byte

zero_page.name: room_hi
zero_page.meaning: current room, high bit

zero_page.name: kiniport_index
zero_page.meaning: scratch; not meaningful across a save

zero_page.name: fatigue_cause
zero_page.meaning: 0 none, 1 out of food, 2 out of rest

zero_page.name: fatigue
zero_page.meaning: down-counter; one lap costs one food and one rest

zero_page.name: dream_state
zero_page.meaning: 0 normal, 1 rested in the sky nid, 255 in the clouds

zero_page.name: lamp_index
zero_page.meaning: object number of the lit honeylamp, 0 = none

zero_page.name: lamp_fuel
zero_page.meaning: room changes of light left

zero_page.name: take_permission
zero_page.meaning: an item was offered; cleared on room load

zero_page.name: door_permission
zero_page.meaning: a gate was paid for; cleared on room load

zero_page.name: falla_key_revealed
zero_page.meaning: D'ol Falla's key may be taken

zero_page.name: wissenberries_offered
zero_page.meaning: count offered to the room 352 guard

zero_page.name: creature_hit
zero_page.meaning: pending ambush effect; normally 0

zero_page.name: saved_room_lo
zero_page.meaning: room to return to; SAVE copies it into room_lo first

zero_page.name: saved_room_hi
zero_page.meaning: room high bit to return to

zero_page.name: character
zero_page.meaning: selected character 0-4

zero_page.name: menu_item
zero_page.meaning: main-menu highlight; not quest state

zero_page.name: quest_active
zero_page.meaning: a quest is in progress

zero_page.name: attract_state
zero_page.meaning: attract/menu state; not quest state

zero_page.name: storage_item
zero_page.meaning: DISK STORAGE highlight; not quest state

zero_page.name: quest_slot
zero_page.meaning: save slot 0-4; not quest state

zero_page.name: vision_count
zero_page.meaning: visions already shown, 0-5

zero_page.name: pense_message_count
zero_page.meaning: animals pensed, 0-5

zero_page.name: quest_time_up
zero_page.meaning: the day-51 timeout fired

zero_page.name: spirit_bell_rang
zero_page.meaning: the bell is ringing in this cell

save: room_lo/room_hi <- saved_room_lo/saved_room_hi so the room the player left is what gets written
copy the live object table into the buffer
copy the live variable page into the buffer
copy zero page $80-$FF into the buffer
the creature flag arrays already live inside the range, so nothing is copied for them
scratch the old file, then write the whole range
load: stash which character sprite file is in memory, because the variable page is about to be overwritten
load the file at its own address
copy the three regions back into the live locations
return to the main menu; CONTINUE then reloads the character file if the saved character differs

not_saved: the room block itself -- it is re-read from the data disk
anything about the world layout; only object placement moves
the character sprite file, which is reloaded by name
the score: nothing is written on either ending
